rationale: Accept bounded evidence recovery through the now verified Work runtime; no new provider, scheduler or storage changes. Evidence gaps may yield partial closure.

dimensions.problem_solution_fit: Recover exact missing proof rather than rebuild discovery.
dimensions.alternatives: Work runtime is available; Colab introduces avoidable sign-in dependency.
dimensions.architecture_tradeoffs: Reuse canonical code and hash-pinned checkers.
dimensions.complexity: One evidence pass and integration; no generic orchestration framework.
dimensions.security_compliance: Zero provider API calls, copied transcripts or public/KC/D1 writes.
dimensions.cost: Zero paid services; normal required CI only.
dimensions.failure_scenarios: Source authorship overrides publisher count: retain qualification history but reconcile Heath lineage and test duplicate-key coverage before synthesis.
dimensions.acceptance_criteria: Current forty-item queue and unique-lineage coverage, with source-gated synthesis.
dimensions.roadmap_alignment: Isolated registered P2 lane under owner recovery steering.
